svg.aria-label: Stitch Loop press: live product signals — the codebase and live metrics — ride a belt into a machine with four drums, Suggest, Solve, Build and Reflect, that run the evergreen loop, with an overhead return rail carrying what was learned back to Suggest. At the end a STOP gate holds the finished GitHub pull request until a human pulls the lit APPROVE lever, so nothing merges without review. Numbers from the Nov 18, 2026 launch: 180+ integrations, 3 default loops, 4 steps per loop, running 24/7, 0 merges without review.
svg.text: NOV 18, 2026 · 180+ INTEGRATIONS · 3 LOOPS · 4 STEPS · 24/7 · 0 MERGES WITHOUT REVIEW
